Days of the Week

For teachers and tutors

About Days of the Week

A listening and spelling game for the seven days, Monday to Sunday. Days start with a capital letter and the game marks that, so learners learn to write them properly. Multiple choice is there for learners who cannot type yet.

How to play

  1. Listen to the day.
  2. Type it with a capital letter.
  3. Check it.

Play it as a class

Choose Days of the Week in the Teacher Game, then ask "What day is today?"
